item.description: An armed man was shot and killed after entering the secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, President Donald Trump’s resort in Palm Beach, Florida. item.title: AP Was There: An Olympic ‘Miracle On Ice’ as US shocks USSR
item.description: The victory by the U.S. men's hockey team over the heavily favored Soviet Union at the 1980 Winter Olympics is widely regarded as one of the greatest upsets in sports history. The 46th anniversary of that game was Sunday, Feb. 22 — the same day the American men won Olympic hockey gold for the first time since 1980. item.title: NASA will return its moon rocket to the hangar for more repairs before astronauts strap in
item.description: NASA's giant moon rocket is headed back to the hangar for more repairs. The space agency said Sunday it's targeting Tuesday for the four-mile trek, weather permitting. NASA had barely finished a repeat fueling test last week to ensure hydrogen fuel leaks were plugged when another problem cropped up. This time, the rocket's helium system malfunctioned, further delaying astronauts' first trip to the moon in decades. item.title: US men’s hockey gold medal and Eileen Gu’s halfpipe victory highlight final day of Winter Olympics
item.description: The Americans are bringing men's hockey gold home for the first time in nearly half a century. Eileen Gu is now six-for-six in Olympic medal events after another gold in the halfpipe. Also on the final day of the Milan Cortina Game there was Germany’s Johannes Lochner adding the four-man gold to his two-man bobsled title. item.title: US futures, bitcoin fall and Asian markets are mixed after the Supreme Court nixes Trump’s tariffs
item.description: U.S. futures have dropped and Asian shares are mostly higher after the Supreme Court struck down most of President Donald Trump’s sweeping tariffs. Bitcoin tumbled as much as 5% early Monday. Tokyo's markets were closed for a holiday. The S&P 500 added 0.7% Friday. It had been flipping between small gains and losses before the court’s ruling, following discouraging reports showing slowing growth for the U.S. economy and faster inflation. item.title: Trial begins for Utah mom accused of killing husband then writing a children’s book about grief
item.description: A murder trial is set to begin for a Utah mother of three who published a children’s book about grief after her husband’s death and was later accused of killing him. Kouri Richins faces a slew of felony charges for allegedly killing her husband with fentanyl in March 2022 at their home just outside the ski town of Park City.
